answer: In this PoA design, each identity posts bonded collateral in escrow, while correlated equivocation links evidence and triggers a quadratic penalty: coordinating k identities burns O(k^2) collateral rather than k times one fine. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier further increases capital loss, making a sybil swarm economically untenable. Identities called meadow, walnut, or zephyr cannot dilute accountability; asymmetric depreciation and slashing exceed any attack gain.
